plain: Abandoning or neglecting something you are bound to uphold, such as a duty.

webster.text: The act of leaving with an intention not to reclaim; an utter forsaking; abandonment.

example.quote: If this had been done, it would doubtless have been interpreted into an entire dereliction of the federal principle; and would certainly have deprived the State governments of that absolute safeguard which they will enjoy under this provision.
